notes.title: Beta Test Start Announcement
notes.content:
To all Rogue Gladius Survivors players
We will be holding a beta test prior to the release!

■Beta Test Period
Wednesday, September 4, 2024 to Saturday, October 12, 2024
* Players' game progress and data will be erased without notice during and at the end of the beta period. Please note this in advance.


■Request for Survey
We ask all participants in the beta test to participate in a survey to improve the quality of the game.
We will give a special gift to everyone who answers the survey below.
We will add your name to the in-game credits as a ""special thanks"" to all who answer the survey.
Click here to fill out the survey.

The results of the beta test will be used to make the game better.
Please enjoy Rogue Gladius Survivors during the beta test!
Please add it to your wishlist! !

■How to Operate
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3324831083

The Rogue Gladius Survivors team
